title: Unlabelled continuous-load episode, 19 May 2020

ground_truth.note: a 24-hour stuck-loaded episode with the purge signature of the labelled failures, never reported and therefore never labelled; what the run should show is whether the pipeline finds it

design_target.provenance: inferred from the signature-A analysis, unverified (a design case since 2026-09-24): the episode shows the stuck-loaded, raised-purge-pressure signature of F1-F3, whose accepted causes these are, but nobody reported or labelled it, so this is a design aid for the tuning list and never ground truth

notes: One of the twelve unlabelled episodes of the failure table, from 22:22:17 on 19 May to 23:02:33 on 20 May. The failure table excludes it rather than counting it either way, so this scenario is reported and never gated: finding it is evidence the detector generalises, missing it proves nothing. Since 2026-09-24 it is a design case: the tuning readout and the threshold sweep report its tickets and decisions inside the episode against design_target, which no gate, exit eval or threshold selection reads.
